acceptance: Each verb has a journey test on recorded real shapes: the workspace of cycle 2157, and a CI log that holds nested fixture FAIL lines
debug ci names only real failures on that log
debug gates reports every red gate in one run
A guard fails if a debug verb calls a state-changing function
100 percent coverage on the changed functions, and exit codes in cli_contract_verbs
fix: Add a read-only verb family evolve debug: cycles (one row per cycle: phase, scope, verdict, termination, class, ship), cycle N (the failure brief with the cause, the evidence and a next step), ci RUN (failed step names, real package failures and the end message of a coverage gate, with no fixture text), gates (cover-changed, cover-strict and apicover from one local profile, all reported, with no stop at the first red), trees (each dev worktree: branch, head, staged, fence state, its PR, and if it composes on main). Reuse wave.ReadRunCycles, ci classify, dossier show and integration batch dry-run. Each verb has --json. A guard proves that the family writes no repository, inbox or ledger state. A second item owns a state-changing verb for review, gate and commit.
summary: The operator asked for a debug CLI in evolve, covered with tests, in place of the bash and python scratch scripts of the console. Those scripts broke the Go-only and CLI-only rules and caused real errors in one session: a blanket restore erased seat work, a bash 3.2 parse error stopped four seats, tail hid a refused verb, and a state-changing sync-main ran inside a read-only check. Each read below was written by hand several times.
title: Build evolve debug so the console needs no scratch scripts
